# Use the music player controls on iPhone

You can play and control music in the Music app ![](https://ipcdn-web.apple.com/assets/v2/web/f5876335-91f1-4a11-8d64-162d62bd3704) in two different ways—the MiniPlayer and the Now Playing screen.

**Tip:** Swipe left or right across the title of a track in the MiniPlayer or the Now Playing screen to navigate between tracks.

## Use the MiniPlayer

The MiniPlayer shows the song that’s currently playing. You can use the MiniPlayer to play or pause music, or skip to the next track.

![The Library tab, showing the MiniPlayer near the bottom. The MiniPlayer shows the title of the song that’s playing. The Pause and Next Track buttons are to the right of the song title. Tap the MiniPlayer to open the Now Playing screen.](https://ipcdn-web.apple.com/assets/v2/web/56b8089a-6cb2-4df5-b2d9-9004bedb63a6)

## Use the controls in the Now Playing screen

![The Now Playing screen showing the various controls and buttons.](https://ipcdn-web.apple.com/assets/v2/web/2a0095cf-3303-4409-a9a9-a420ef451563)

1. Go to the Music app ![](https://ipcdn-web.apple.com/assets/v2/web/f5876335-91f1-4a11-8d64-162d62bd3704) on your iPhone.

2. While a song is playing, tap the MiniPlayer to open the Now Playing screen.

3. Do any of the following:

   - _Adjust the volume:_ Drag the volume slider.

     You can also use the volume buttons on the side of iPhone.

   - _Scrub to any point in a song:_ Drag the playhead.

   - _Navigate to the artist, album, or playlist:_ Tap the artist name below the song title, then choose an option.

   - _Turn animated album cover art on or off:_ Go to Settings ![](https://ipcdn-web.apple.com/assets/v2/web/7a308937-68e6-4db0-a6e5-1a4d7dc37166) \> Apps > Music, then tap Animated Art and choose an option.

For additional control over your music, tap any of these buttons:

|     |     |
| --- | --- |
| **Control** | **Description** |
| ![The Dismiss Now Playing Screen button.](https://ipcdn-web.apple.com/assets/v2/web/4ca7c82a-03bc-49b3-a9a0-7ebb8165c561) | Dismiss the Now Playing screen. |
| ![The Favorite button.](https://ipcdn-web.apple.com/assets/v2/web/d0ba093a-24b4-40ce-b345-a6eeda3aa06a) | Mark the song as a favorite. See [Mark items as favorites](https://support.apple.com/guide/iphone/mark-items-as-favorites-iphbb0f5ff34/27/ios/27). |
| ![The More button.](https://ipcdn-web.apple.com/assets/v2/web/5d2e012a-8b1a-4097-ab3d-5537725b7294) | Tap for more options. |
| ![The Shuffle button.](https://ipcdn-web.apple.com/assets/v2/web/da86818f-1bfd-49f7-b2ff-a99714cdf3fa) | Tap to play your songs in random order (shuffle). |
| ![The Repeat button.](https://ipcdn-web.apple.com/assets/v2/web/23d40c5f-1240-4f29-9064-98efd9cb1d67) | Tap to repeat an album, playlist, or the entire queue. (Or double-tap to repeat a single song.) |
| ![The AutoPlay button.](https://ipcdn-web.apple.com/assets/v2/web/a6e8caf2-14d7-4e8b-956f-6c551b10fffd) | Tap to use AutoPlay, which adds similar songs and plays them at the end of the queue. |
| ![The AutoMix button.](https://ipcdn-web.apple.com/assets/v2/web/831ace1a-53bf-4e7b-a410-7e92b5c78c63) | Tap to use [AutoMix](https://support.apple.com/guide/iphone/aside/iphcba31c44b/27/ios/27), which seamlessly transitions between songs, like a DJ. (Available for Apple Music subscribers.) |
| ![The Crossfade button.](https://ipcdn-web.apple.com/assets/v2/web/7fc0b902-39e8-4886-a9d3-d4d8e7bde501) | Tap to use Crossfade, which fades in each song (gradually increase its volume) while the previous song is fading out. |
| ![The Translation and Pronunciation button.](https://ipcdn-web.apple.com/assets/v2/web/d7765a00-6203-42cd-8164-a7a75ff9b5c5) | Tap when you need help pronouncing or translating the lyrics. This button only appears when a translation or pronunciation is available that matches your iPhone device’s Preferred Languages list. (You can view this list and add languages directly to it in Settings ![](https://ipcdn-web.apple.com/assets/v2/web/7a308937-68e6-4db0-a6e5-1a4d7dc37166) \> General > Language & Region.) Not available in all languages. |
| ![The Previous Track button.](https://ipcdn-web.apple.com/assets/v2/web/3bf1d9eb-f84d-40a1-b706-d43b32bd9ecb) | Go back to the beginning of the song. Tap again to play the previous song in an album or playlist. Touch and hold to rewind through the current song. |
| ![The Pause button.](https://ipcdn-web.apple.com/assets/v2/web/239cbb44-b2bf-44fe-8b4f-e71b6c76eb02) | Pause playback. |
| ![The Play button.](https://ipcdn-web.apple.com/assets/v2/web/016c9d60-1b02-4b08-973e-5eb4cd64ca8c) | Play the current song. |
| ![The Next Track button.](https://ipcdn-web.apple.com/assets/v2/web/eec2dda0-c859-492f-86bb-6e5d95814ec1) | Skip to the next song. Touch and hold to fast-forward through the current song. |
| ![The Lyrics button.](https://ipcdn-web.apple.com/assets/v2/web/c9cf6309-6faa-4a2e-95c9-895301850299) | Show time-synced lyrics (lyrics not available for all songs). |
| ![The Playback Destination button.](https://ipcdn-web.apple.com/assets/v2/web/92d3b309-91a2-4eb4-bd72-84e083af9b0a) | Stream music to Bluetooth or AirPlay-enabled devices. |
| ![The Playing Next button.](https://ipcdn-web.apple.com/assets/v2/web/87ff874a-11b4-41fc-a235-fd6661c181b3) | [Show the queue](https://support.apple.com/guide/iphone/queue-up-your-music-ipha4521ef7d/27/ios/27). |

## Stream music to Bluetooth® or AirPlay-enabled devices

1. Go to the Music app ![](https://ipcdn-web.apple.com/assets/v2/web/f5876335-91f1-4a11-8d64-162d62bd3704) on your iPhone.

2. While a song is playing, tap the MiniPlayer to open the Now Playing screen.

3. Tap ![the Playback Destination button](https://ipcdn-web.apple.com/assets/v2/web/380578db-3ad2-4626-8efd-829d13b180a7), then choose a device.


See [Play audio from iPhone on HomePod and other wireless speakers](https://support.apple.com/guide/iphone/homepod-and-other-wireless-speakers-iph315e0d58d/27/ios/27).

_Note:_ You can play the same music on multiple AirPlay 2-enabled devices, such as two or more HomePod speakers. You can also pair two sets of AirPods to one iPhone and enjoy the same song or movie along with a friend. See [Play audio on multiple AirPlay 2-enabled devices](https://support.apple.com/guide/iphone/homepod-and-other-wireless-speakers-iph315e0d58d/27/ios/27#iphe3c744656) in this user guide and [Share audio with AirPods and Beats headphones](https://support.apple.com/guide/airpods/dev3786f35c8) in the AirPods User Guide.

**See also** [Adjust the sound quality in Music on iPhone](https://support.apple.com/guide/iphone/adjust-the-sound-quality-iph5643d2c85/27/ios/27) [Play music on iPhone](https://support.apple.com/guide/iphone/play-music-iph0138fb328/27/ios/27)

# Use the music player controls in Apple Music Classical

When you play music in Apple Music Classical, you can view the song playing at the bottom of your screen (on iPhone, iPad, or Android) or at the top of the screen (on the web). Alternatively, you can make the player smaller (MiniPlayer) or larger (Full Screen Player).

## Change Classical player views in the app

When you’re playing music in the Classical app, you can view the MiniPlayer or the Full Screen Player. The MiniPlayer shows the composer name, the work title, and the track that’s currently playing. You can use the MiniPlayer to play or pause music, or skip to the next track. The Full Screen Player shows the album details, including the cover, and additional controls, such as the AirPlay button.

![An iPhone showing the MiniPlayer in Apple Music Classical. At the top of the screen is album art and the name of the work. The MiniPlayer is near the bottom of the screen. Below the MiniPlayer are the Home, Library, and Search buttons.](https://ipcdn-web.apple.com/assets/v2/web/cb0d4698-b73d-42fc-991a-79be73b955db)

1. Go to the Apple Music Classical app ![](https://ipcdn-web.apple.com/assets/v2/web/19e66341-fa2e-409e-b255-80e7e53f745b) on your iPhone, iPad, or Android device.

2. [Play classical music](https://support.apple.com/guide/apple-music-classical/play-music-deva5dadffc9/1.0/web/1.0#3b67bb65-e22c-4a72-8788-2dec58f76c3d).

3. Do any of the following:

   - _Switch from the MiniPlayer to the Full Screen Player:_ Tap the MiniPlayer.

   - _Switch from the Full Screen Player to the MiniPlayer:_ Swipe down.

## Change Classical player views on the web

When you’re playing classical music on the web, you can view the MiniPlayer or the Full Screen Player. Both views show the album details, including the cover, and additional controls, such as the Favorite button.

1. Go to [classical.music.apple.com](https://classical.music.apple.com/)![](https://ipcdn-web.apple.com/assets/v2/web/19e66341-fa2e-409e-b255-80e7e53f745b).

2. [Play classical music](https://support.apple.com/guide/apple-music-classical/play-music-deva5dadffc9/1.0/web/1.0#90a44530-cc9c-4acb-9c9e-95251a206560).

3. Do any of the following:

   - _Switch to the Full Screen Player:_ [Select](https://support.apple.com/guide/apple-music-classical/aside/glosa85382ba/1.0/web/1.0) the album artwork at the top of the window.

   - _Switch from the Full Screen Player to the MiniPlayer:_ Reduce the width of the window—drag the right or left edge inward—until the Close button ![](https://ipcdn-web.apple.com/assets/v2/web/3981bc8a-2fa6-45b7-95b2-d3accfb9408a) appears.

   - _Exit the MiniPlayer:_ Select ![the Close button](https://ipcdn-web.apple.com/assets/v2/web/3981bc8a-2fa6-45b7-95b2-d3accfb9408a) at the top of the window, then expand the window size as needed.

## Player controls in Apple Music Classical

![An iPhone showing the Now Playing screen in Apple Music Classical. At the top of the screen is a gray bar that you tap to hide the Now Playing screen and switch back to the MiniPlayer. Beneath the bar is album art, the name of the work, and the timeline, which shows the length of the track and how much time has elapsed. In the lower part of the screen are the Skip Backward, Pause, and Skip Forward buttons, the volume control, and the Info, AirPlay, and Playing Next buttons.](https://ipcdn-web.apple.com/assets/v2/web/5f29ad9d-a9cb-4ef0-84b4-2ddf1f7941ec)

Below are the various player controls in Apple Music Classical.

| Control | Description |
| --- | --- |
| ![The Play button.](https://ipcdn-web.apple.com/assets/v2/web/d778edb4-8323-49c4-9375-0441c9c319aa) | Play the current track. |
| ![The Pause button.](https://ipcdn-web.apple.com/assets/v2/web/a8fb4c3f-7721-4da4-89fc-45c7fcc9ab1d) | Pause playback. |
| ![The Previous Track button.](https://ipcdn-web.apple.com/assets/v2/web/3d84431e-e0b7-4f5e-b537-3c1b447747c8) | Go back to the beginning of the track. [Select](https://support.apple.com/guide/apple-music-classical/aside/glosa85382ba/1.0/web/1.0) again to play the previous track in an album or [playlist](https://support.apple.com/guide/apple-music-classical/aside/glos9d34e928/1.0/web/1.0). |
| ![The Next Track button.](https://ipcdn-web.apple.com/assets/v2/web/ba83d16a-518f-4d12-95d4-3f7e5a84863e) | Skip to the next track. |
| ![The More button.](https://ipcdn-web.apple.com/assets/v2/web/73f6672b-4ea9-4770-9f2c-9d05a3c781ee) | Select for more options (on iPhone, iPad, or the web). |
| ![The Menu button.](https://ipcdn-web.apple.com/assets/v2/web/e2696440-372e-469d-b89e-4801cff808e3) | Tap for more options (on Android devices). |
| ![the Info button](https://ipcdn-web.apple.com/assets/v2/web/450268d5-5373-410d-a67b-9e7ccb88e0e4) | Display information about the music you’re playing, such as the record label or release date. |
| ![The Hide Info button.](https://ipcdn-web.apple.com/assets/v2/web/f66ebb7e-8265-4d82-b0f9-a52922023276) | Hide information about the music you’re playing. (On the web, the Hide Info button looks like this **![](https://ipcdn-web.apple.com/assets/v2/web/b4b14a47-2aff-4801-bdaf-d71cb9a91b74)**.) |
| ![The Info button.](https://ipcdn-web.apple.com/assets/v2/web/9b063a13-f6fb-4ceb-9403-a76a1ae454f7) | Display the listening guide—real-time notes—for a recording as it’s playing (iPhone, iPad, and Android only). |
| ![The Hide Info button.](https://ipcdn-web.apple.com/assets/v2/web/f4b946ec-0f77-4cb1-97a7-cba127c4eb7b) | Hide the listening guide for a recording as it’s playing (iPhone, iPad, and Android only). |
| ![The Playback Destination button.](https://ipcdn-web.apple.com/assets/v2/web/788513fb-6f92-4e01-adaa-059bab24c915) | [Stream](https://support.apple.com/guide/apple-music-classical/aside/glos797cd2b3/1.0/web/1.0) music to Bluetooth or AirPlay-enabled devices (iPhone and iPad only). |
| ![The Chromecast button.](https://ipcdn-web.apple.com/assets/v2/web/6707f4df-faf6-4cf0-88de-89e22229bdbc) | Cast (stream) music to Chromecast devices on the same Wi-Fi network (iPhone, iPad, and Android only). |
| ![The Playing Next button.](https://ipcdn-web.apple.com/assets/v2/web/de1a76d5-bb41-497f-8aee-0431a0b53c6c) | Display upcoming tracks from the playlist, album, or recording you’re currently listening to. (On the web, the Playing Next button looks like this ![](https://ipcdn-web.apple.com/assets/v2/web/4689846e-2806-4a9b-aa84-c529a5d6384e).) |
| ![The Repeat button.](https://ipcdn-web.apple.com/assets/v2/web/cfe56831-72f7-415e-863c-a6675d99ca8c) | Open the queue, then tap to repeat an album or playlist. Double-tap to repeat a single track. (On the web, the Repeat button looks like this ![](https://ipcdn-web.apple.com/assets/v2/web/04ae45af-134c-42fe-ab86-f8cee77ed488).) |
| ![The Hide Playing Next button.](https://ipcdn-web.apple.com/assets/v2/web/3db05114-0f23-409a-a3b6-c91b35f0d70a) | Hide upcoming tracks. (On the web, the Hide Playing Next button looks like this **![](https://ipcdn-web.apple.com/assets/v2/web/770d39c0-5c18-4e46-b48e-f85df6aa73f0)**.) |

**See also** [Add music to your library in Apple Music Classical](https://support.apple.com/guide/apple-music-classical/add-music-to-your-library-deva6f6bfa76/1.0/web/1.0)

# Queue up your music on iPhone

Use the queue to see a list of upcoming songs, add songs and videos to the queue, and see what you recently played.

## Use the queue

1. Go to the Music app ![](https://ipcdn-web.apple.com/assets/v2/web/60117d60-bf59-4dac-9e68-47a60fa26338) on your iPhone.

2. While a song is playing, tap the [MiniPlayer](https://support.apple.com/guide/iphone/aside/iphba6e7fce6/27/ios/27) to open the Now Playing screen.

3. Tap ![the Playing Next button](https://ipcdn-web.apple.com/assets/v2/web/b667a8d7-7ef4-4657-899c-a57775b75943), then tap a song to play it and the songs that follow.

To reorder the list, drag ![the Reorder button](https://ipcdn-web.apple.com/assets/v2/web/3c7c3b19-f3e3-4226-b5d9-e13ae2a36d22). To do more, see [Manage the queue](https://support.apple.com/guide/iphone/queue-up-your-music-ipha4521ef7d/27/ios/27#iphd085d448f).

4. Tap ![the Playing Next button](https://ipcdn-web.apple.com/assets/v2/web/b667a8d7-7ef4-4657-899c-a57775b75943) again to hide the queue.


## Add music and music videos to the queue

1. Go to the Music app ![](https://ipcdn-web.apple.com/assets/v2/web/60117d60-bf59-4dac-9e68-47a60fa26338) on your iPhone.

2. While browsing or playing music, touch and hold a song, album, playlist, or video, then choose an option:

   - _Add music right after the currently playing item:_ Tap Play Next.

   - _Add music to the end of the queue:_ Tap Play After or Add to Queue.

**Tip:** If you’re using HomePod to stream music and your friends are on [the same Wi-Fi network](https://support.apple.com/guide/iphone/aside/iph7fb8ae622/27/ios/27), they can add items to the queue. To learn more about HomePod speaker access, see the [HomePod User Guide](https://support.apple.com/guide/homepod/welcome).

## Use AutoPlay to add songs to the queue

If [you’re an Apple Music subscriber](https://support.apple.com/guide/iphone/subscribe-to-apple-music-iphcfadf0701/27/ios/27#iph4c856eb23) and you’re not sure what to play next, use AutoPlay. When you play something, AutoPlay adds similar songs and plays them at the end of the queue. When AutoPlay is on and a song is playing, the AutoPlay icon ![](https://ipcdn-web.apple.com/assets/v2/web/870abbd5-d021-48f7-b801-b52d9af3c163) appears at the top of the queue.

![The Now Playing screen showing the queue with AutoPlay and AutoMix turned on. Similar songs appear below the songs in the queue.](https://ipcdn-web.apple.com/assets/v2/web/5b954199-4339-4d17-b01a-5da802f5b92e)

1. Go to the Music app ![](https://ipcdn-web.apple.com/assets/v2/web/60117d60-bf59-4dac-9e68-47a60fa26338) on your iPhone.

2. While a song is playing, tap the [MiniPlayer](https://support.apple.com/guide/iphone/aside/iphba6e7fce6/27/ios/27) to open the Now Playing screen.

3. Tap ![the Playing Next button](https://ipcdn-web.apple.com/assets/v2/web/b667a8d7-7ef4-4657-899c-a57775b75943), then tap ![the AutoPlay button](https://ipcdn-web.apple.com/assets/v2/web/870abbd5-d021-48f7-b801-b52d9af3c163) at the top of the queue to turn AutoPlay on.

When AutoPlay is on, the button changes color. Tap it again to turn it off.



_Note:_ When you turn off AutoPlay on a device that uses your Apple Account—your iPhone, for example—AutoPlay is turned off on all other devices that use the same Apple Account.


## Manage the queue

1. Go to the Music app ![](https://ipcdn-web.apple.com/assets/v2/web/60117d60-bf59-4dac-9e68-47a60fa26338) on your iPhone.

2. While a song is playing, tap the [MiniPlayer](https://support.apple.com/guide/iphone/aside/iphba6e7fce6/27/ios/27) to open the Now Playing screen.

3. Tap ![the Playing Next button](https://ipcdn-web.apple.com/assets/v2/web/b667a8d7-7ef4-4657-899c-a57775b75943), then do any of the following:

   - _Change the order of songs in the queue:_ Drag the songs into the order you want them to play.

   - _Add more songs to the queue:_ Scroll below the Queue section, then tap Add Songs to Queue.

   - _Remove a song from the queue:_ Swipe left on the song, then tap ![the minus button](https://ipcdn-web.apple.com/assets/v2/web/83cf28ff-032c-4e69-a268-6dddc30c64fb).

   - _See how many songs are in the queue:_ Scroll to the bottom of the queue.

     When [multiple songs are repeating](https://support.apple.com/guide/iphone/shuffle-or-repeat-songs-iphe22408524/27/ios/27), you can see how many songs will be repeated instead.

   - _Remove all songs from the queue:_ Tap Clear at the top of the queue.

**Tip:** If you’re using HomePod to stream music and your friends are on [the same Wi-Fi network](https://support.apple.com/guide/iphone/aside/iph7fb8ae622/27/ios/27), they can reorder items in the queue. To learn more about HomePod speaker access, see the [HomePod User Guide](https://support.apple.com/guide/homepod/welcome).

## See what you recently played

1. Go to the Music app ![](https://ipcdn-web.apple.com/assets/v2/web/60117d60-bf59-4dac-9e68-47a60fa26338) on your iPhone.

2. While a song is playing, tap the [MiniPlayer](https://support.apple.com/guide/iphone/aside/iphba6e7fce6/27/ios/27) to open the Now Playing screen.

3. Tap ![the Playing Next button](https://ipcdn-web.apple.com/assets/v2/web/b667a8d7-7ef4-4657-899c-a57775b75943), then swipe down to see your playing history.

To play a song in the history, tap it. To remove your playing history, tap Clear.


## Turn on or off song transitions in the queue

1. Go to the Music app ![](https://ipcdn-web.apple.com/assets/v2/web/60117d60-bf59-4dac-9e68-47a60fa26338) on your iPhone.

2. Tap ![the Playing Next button](https://ipcdn-web.apple.com/assets/v2/web/b667a8d7-7ef4-4657-899c-a57775b75943), then tap ![the AutoMix button](https://ipcdn-web.apple.com/assets/v2/web/428ab21c-a502-4a7a-b865-a886fb4084d3) or ![the Crossfade button](https://ipcdn-web.apple.com/assets/v2/web/1a105206-4867-4355-a31d-6c74479b832e) in the top-right corner to turn on or off [AutoMix](https://support.apple.com/guide/iphone/aside/iphcba31c44b/27/ios/27) or Crossfade.

To change between AutoMix or Crossfade, see [Change how music transitions](https://support.apple.com/guide/iphone/transition-songs-iphadf2fe1f4/27/ios/27#iph27b457754).


**See also** [Shuffle or repeat songs in Music on iPhone](https://support.apple.com/guide/iphone/shuffle-or-repeat-songs-iphe22408524/27/ios/27) [Play music on iPhone](https://support.apple.com/guide/iphone/play-music-iph0138fb328/27/ios/27) [Adjust the sound quality in Music on iPhone](https://support.apple.com/guide/iphone/adjust-the-sound-quality-iph5643d2c85/27/ios/27)
